# VITL Raises $7.5M in Series A Funding

 By FinSMEs 

March 27, 2026

VITL, a Nashville, TN-based provider of an operating system for cash-pay health, raised $7.5M in Series A funding.

The round was led by SignalFire.

The company intends to use the funds to expand its network of verified pharmacy partners, develop clinical program management and subscription workflow tools, invest in interoperability that connects to the broader healthcare ecosystem, and scale the team at its Nashville headquarters.

Founded in 2024 by CEO Charlie Jordan, VITL is a healthtech company building an operating system for cash-pay health. Through its open marketplace, it connects clinics with verified 503A and 503B compounding pharmacies nationwide, enabling real-time price comparison, multi-pharmacy ordering, and patient tracking from prescription to doorstep, all through a single interface. 

The company serves over 630 clinics and 1,000+ prescribers across the United States.
